scripts.docker:build-only: docker buildx build -t adessilly/billy-layout:$(npm run -s lib:version) -t adessilly/billy-layout:latest . --load
scripts.docker:deploy-only: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t adessilly/billy-layout:$(npm run -s lib:version) -t adessilly/billy-layout:latest . --push
scripts.docker:build: npm i --force && npm run build:prod && npm run docker:build-only
scripts.docker:deploy: npm i --force && npm run build:prod && npm run docker:deploy-only
scripts.deploy:lib: npm run build:lib && npm publish ./dist/billy-layout --registry https://registry.npmjs.org/
